title: Notifications
emptyBody: Your weekly summary, reached goals and reminders about valuations to update will show up here.
staleBody: Positions with an outdated valuation or no price: {count}. Update them in Assets.
prefsLead: Turn each type on or off separately for the app and for email.
typeWeeklyHint: On Mondays: how your net worth changed over the last week.
typeGoalHint: Once per goal, when the value reaches the target.
typeStaleHint: At most once a week, when some positions have an old valuation.
typeSecurityHint: New device, password or two-step verification change: always by email, cannot be turned off.
emailOff: Sending email is turned off (no mail provider). Notifications only appear in the app.
emailUnverified: Confirm your email address in security settings to turn on email notifications.
pushNote: Push notifications on iPhone will come with the app; they never include amounts.
